canonical_project: Amazon AWS Incheon / Gajwa Tech Center
notes: DCD reported AWS is building a data center in Seo-gu, Incheon. Maeil Business News said AWS began building a mega-scale data center in the Seo-gu industrial area after purchasing the site and receiving design approval, with about 100 MW. Cushman & Wakefield's 2H 2024 construction list identifies Incheon Gajwa Tech Center, operator/developer AWS, 42,454 sqm and 16 MW initial / 96 MW total capacity. Data Center Map identifies the site at 585-49/585-1 Gajwa-dong, Seo-gu.
